Given data:
Supply voltage $V = 240\text{ V}$, $f = 50\text{ Hz}$, $\omega = 2\pi(50) = 314.16\text{ rad/s}$.

**Branch 1 (Coil):**
$R_1 = 5\ \Omega$, $L_1 = 38.2\text{ mH} = 0.0382\text{ H}$.
$X_{L1} = \omega L_1 = 314.16 \times 0.0382 = 12\ \Omega$.
Impedance $Z_1 = 5 + j12\ \Omega = 13 \angle 67.38^\circ\ \Omega$.
Current $I_1 = \frac{V}{Z_1} = \frac{240 \angle 0^\circ}{13 \angle 67.38^\circ} = 18.46 \angle -67.38^\circ\text{ A}$ ($7.08 - j17.03\text{ A}$).

**Branch 2 ($R-C$ Series):**
$R_2 = 16\ \Omega$, $C = 300\ \mu\text{F} = 300 \times 10^{-6}\text{ F}$.
$X_{C2} = \frac{1}{\omega C} = \frac{1}{314.16 \times 300 \times 10^{-6}} = 10.61\ \Omega$.
Impedance $Z_2 = 16 - j10.61\ \Omega = 19.19 \angle -33.56^\circ\ \Omega$.
Current $I_2 = \frac{V}{Z_2} = \frac{240 \angle 0^\circ}{19.19 \angle -33.56^\circ} = 12.51 \angle 33.56^\circ\text{ A}$ ($10.42 - j6.91\text{ A}$).

**Total Current ($I$):**
$$I = I_1 + I_2 = (7.08 - j17.03) + (10.42 - j6.91) = 17.5 - j23.94\text{ A}$$
$$I = \sqrt{17.5^2 + (-23.94)^2} = 29.65 \angle -53.82^\circ\text{ A}$$

**Total Impedance ($Z_{total}$):**
$$Z_{total} = \frac{V}{I} = \frac{240}{29.65} = 8.10\ \Omega$$

**Overall Power Factor ($pf$):**
$$pf = \cos(-53.82^\circ) = 0.59\text{ lagging}$$.
proTip: Always convert individual branch impedances to polar form to find currents easily, then convert to rectangular form for vector addition.
